description.value: Bubble TastyTea is an independent bubble tea shop founded by a young couple in Abbotsford, BC, offering an extensive menu of milk teas, fruit teas, slushes, coffee, and specialty drinks made with premium tea leaves and top-grade toppings. The shop rounds out its menu with bubble waffles and bingsu (shaved ice), making it a more substantial refreshment stop than a typical tea counter. It has built a strong local following since opening and positions itself as Abbotsford's favourite bubble tea destination.
